text:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='crates/elephc-magician/src/interpreter/tests/builtins_file_streams.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old='/// Verifies eval CSV stream builtins format and parse local stream records.'
new=('/// Verifies eval CSV stream builtins format and parse local stream records.\n'
     '///\n'
     "/// `fscanf()`'s `%d` is compared to the INT `42`, not the string `\"42\"`: the strict\n"
     '/// comparison used to read `=== \"42\"` and passed only because the old scanf subset\n'
     '/// answered with the matched text. `php -n` (8.5.6) answers `int(42)` there, so the old\n'
     '/// assertion was pinning a divergence rather than catching it.')
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('doc updated')
PY
